review_text: Really liked this café in Poblacion. Stopped by Revel by Confex and ended up staying longer than we planned. The place has a super cozy feel, with little doodles and artwork everywhere that make it feel very personal and creative. Coffee was good—especially the Einspänner—and the pastries (Carrot cake FTW!!) were solid too. It's the kind of spot you can just sit, chill, and lose track of time a bit. Definitely one of those cafés I'd come back to. ☕️🤎

Really enjoyed the coffee at Revel. The coffee was excellent, the Wi-Fi was fast and reliable, and there were charging outlets available too. Great spot to chill, work, or just enjoy a good cup of coffee.

December 2022 | This review is two years overdue, so I'm not even sure if everything still applies but I wanted to write it anyway because my experience here was genuinely memorable. I had been eyeing this shop for weeks until I eventually reached it by accident while doing my nightly walk along Don Julian Rodriguez Avenue. Two customers were just heading out as I arrived, so I ended up having the entire place to myself. I ordered a slice of cake and a cup of coffee — names I can't remember anymore but both tasted really good. The cake slice, in particular, was huge. I couldn't finish it on my own, and honestly, it's best shared between two to three people. The café is small but very cozy and warm. It feels like a quieter, more relaxed version of Green Coffee near NCCC VP Mall. Davao has plenty of coffee shops, but this one is definitely a charming little hidden gem, a true "hole-in-a-box" cutie.

I love how calming and relaxing this cafe is. I love how if you sit at the tables near the windows you get ample amount of sunlight and i don't know why but it pairs so well with drinking coffee.For its price point it's honestly so affordable and worth it. If you're going to order cake i highly recommend the red velvet cheese cake

I've been here twice. The owner and its staff are very welcoming and accommodating; I guarantee you'll love going back for their coffee and pastries 🥰
Nice, cozy ambiance. Enjoyed their Matcha Strawberry Milk and Einspanner Latte. Their Pecan Bar was great too! I look forward to coming back.
For a small place it's very cozy and the coffee tastes creamy and astounding. I enjoyed the atmosphere here.
Exceptional customer service, fantastic atmosphere, the best coffee I have had around Davao, very good prices, and fantastic deserts. Truly my favourite cafe in Davao and my morning routine.

REVEL by Confex is a cozy, café-style coffee shop tucked inside DBP Village along Don Julian Rodriguez Avenue in Talomo, Davao City. It isn't a resort — instead, it's a local hangout café known for its warm vibes, handcrafted drinks, and sweet treats.
Had the Cheese Buns, Matcha Vanilla Espresso, and Lemonade — everything was really good! The establishment has accommodating staff and a pleasant ambience. The location is easily accessible.
Revel offers delicious coffee and a very relaxing atmosphere. Unfortunately only a few tables are available but you can still stay on the benches. Overall experience is very good

Although, it's hard to park your car since the cafe is just along the highway. But there's a street just before the cafe so we just parked there. I love their caramel latte and their biscoff cookie is soo good!
